root.description: Asset id or uri of the main scene file.

transform.description: Placement in the root scene's axes.

matrix.description: 4×4 column-major (glTF order). When set, translate/rotateDeg/scale are ignored. Written by layer flattening when transforms compose.

upAxis.description: Axes of this file; converted to the root scene's up axis before `transform`. Unset = no conversion.

localTransform.description: Applied in the file's own axes, before the up-axis conversion (written by layer flattening for nested references).

matrix.description: 4×4 column-major (glTF order). When set, translate/rotateDeg/scale are ignored. Written by layer flattening when transforms compose.

materialOverrides.description: Overrides applied to this include only. Keys are material names or "*".

object.description: Only materials used by objects whose name matches.

package.description: Path, https:// URL or asset:// URI of a .renda.json whose scene is placed here.

as.description: Namespace for the referenced package's asset ids (default ref<index>).

matrix.description: 4×4 column-major (glTF order). When set, translate/rotateDeg/scale are ignored. Written by layer flattening when transforms compose.

object.description: Only materials used by objects whose name matches.

upAxis.description: Defaults to the source format's convention. "-Y" = COLMAP/OpenCV (Y down), the usual axes of Gaussian splat captures (.ply/.splat default to it).

unitScale.description: Multiplies scene units. STEP/IGES are converted to metres from their declared units first; this applies on top.

materialOverrides.description: Keys are material names, globs, /regex/flags, or "*" for all.

object.description: Only materials used by objects whose name matches.

textureOverrides.description: Replace material textures with images or videos; later entries win.

texture.description: File name of a texture the material already uses.

slot.description: Default: the slot `texture` matched, else baseColor.

frame.description: Stills: use this source frame instead of startSec.

colorSpace.description: auto: sRGB for baseColor/emission, linear for data maps.

linearDeflection.description: Max chord error in metres. Default: 0.05% of the part's bounding-box diagonal.

angularDeflection.description: Max angle between facets, radians. Default 0.3.

focalLengthMm.description: Overrides fovDeg; measured across sensorWidthMm (the larger image side).

fStop.description: Aperture f-number. Setting it turns depth of field on.

focusDistance.description: Scene units from the camera. Overrides focusTarget.

focusTarget.description: "auto" = the camera target; [x,y,z] = a point; any other string = an object name.

focusTarget.description: "auto" = the camera target; [x,y,z] = a point; any other string = an object name.

hdri.description: Asset id/uri of an equirect .hdr/.exr, or "studio" | "sunset" | "night" built-ins. null = no environment lighting.

motionBlur.description: Needs an animation (a camera turntable or scene animation).

shutter.description: Fraction of a frame the shutter is open (0.5 = 180°).

subframes.description: Samples in time where motion blur is emulated.

turntable.description: Orbit the camera around the scene bounds.

keepFrames.description: Also return individual frames for video outputs.

bake.description: Bake lighting into textures (needs format "glb"). Omit/null with format "glb" = plain conversion to GLB.

uvs.description: auto = generate non-overlapping lightmap UVs (xatlas); existing = reuse TEXCOORD_0 (must not overlap).

margin.description: Padding/dilation in pixels around UV islands.

threshold.description: Display luminance where the glow starts.

extends.description: Packages layered underneath this one, applied in order (later wins; this file wins over all). Objects deep-merge, arrays replace, null removes a field.
